title: Kissed Yeasty German Katsuobushi Bowl
description: A hearty German dish featuring katsuobushi, perfect for a post-workout meal, served in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, cook the pork sausage over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sauerkraut, chicken broth, and apple cider vinegar to the pan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the liquid has reduced by half.
While the mixture is cooking, bake the diced potatoes in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender.
To deglaze the pan, add the yeast extract and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom.
Stir in the katsuobushi and cook for 1 minute.
To serve, place a portion of the potato and sausage mixture into an earthenware bowl and top with additional katsuobushi if desired.
